svg.title: J6 Edit the clinic file on /staff

g.text: J6 Edit the clinic file on /staff
[v1.1: Staff use "Edit with a form" (#clinic-form, closed by default)]
v1.1. The fields follow the file's own shape, so a file
in another shape gets a form too. An "Assistant" section
holds the optional name (at most 40 characters) and the
quick replies (at most 8: label at most 24, question at
nothing is written unless a field was changed; the same "Save clinic file" button stores it
Must be an object with a "clinic" section (name, phone,
emergency_phone, whatsapp, address as text) and an "hours"
section with at least one text entry; "services" and
the answer, the guard and the file sent to api/chat all use the edited file
